# f5xc_api_testing (Resource)

This is the api testing type

To get more information about f5xc_api_testing, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/api-sec-api-testing)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Api Testing - Full

resource "f5xc_api_testing" "example" {
  name                = "example-api-testing"
  namespace           = "default"
  description         = "API testing example"
  custom_header_value = "my-test-header-value"

  labels = {
    env  = "example"
    tier = "api"
  }

  domains = [
    {
      domain                    = "api.example.com"
      allow_destructive_methods = true
      credentials = [
        {
          credential_name = "cred-admin-basic"
          credentials_choice = {
            basic_auth = {
              user = "adminuser"
              password = {
                secret_info_choice = {
                  clear_secret_info = {
                    url = "string:///YWRtaW5wYXNzd29yZA=="
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
          role_choice = {
            admin = true
          }
        },
        {
          credential_name = "cred-std-apikey"
          credentials_choice = {
            api_key = {
              key = "Authorization"
              value = {
                secret_info_choice = {
                  clear_secret_info = {
                    url = "string:///c3RkYXBpa2V5"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
          role_choice = {
            standard = true
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      domain = "staging.example.com"
      credentials = [
        {
          credential_name = "cred-bearer"
          credentials_choice = {
            bearer_token = {
              token = {
                secret_info_choice = {
                  clear_secret_info = {
                    url = "string:///c3RhZ2luZ3Rva2Vu"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
          role_choice = {
            standard = true
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

  frequency_choice = {
    every_day = true
  }
}
```

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell

```

#### HCL Import Block

	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
